concept: MongoDB for VS Code settings and telemetry

claims.text: The historical investigation VSCODE-432 reports millions of Playground Loaded events per day and says the team temporarily disabled the Segment source and event tracking while seeking a cause; it does not establish a present-day event rate or root cause. (low confidence)
The documented `mdb.defaultLimit` default is `10` documents when browsing a collection. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
Open the VS Code Settings view and search for MongoDB to configure the extension; changes save automatically. (low confidence)

VSCODE-738 requests including the format in which documents are displayed or edited in document-edit telemetry events; treat this ticket as implementation intent rather than independent proof of installed behavior. (low confidence)
The repository warns that enabling autocomplete inside snippets or string literals uses global editor settings and may affect other extensions and VS Code performance. (low confidence)

MongoDB documents Send Telemetry as enabled by default and describes its collection as anonymous diagnostic and usage telemetry. Its repository documents setting `mdb.sendTelemetry` to `false` to opt out. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Do not assume the editor telemetry switch disables every extension: Microsoft warns that extensions may collect their own usage data outside `telemetry.telemetryLevel`; MongoDB documents its own `mdb.sendTelemetry` opt-out. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-04)
MongoDB documents opening extension logs through the Command Palette, running Developer: Open Log..., and selecting MongoDB Extension. (low confidence)

The logging documentation illustrates telemetry events containing an `anonymousId`, an event name and properties such as `extension_version` and `device_id`; this example is not an exhaustive inventory of collected data. (low confidence)

The settings reference exposes MongoDB language-server tracing through `mongodbLanguageServer.trace.server`, including `format` and `verbosity`; inspect output by selecting MongoDB Language Server in the Output view. (low confidence)
